'''Jered Opreen''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Opreen managed a small shop, where they also taught the knowledge of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] construction to others.
